remainingVisibleGaps: The raised shoulders are continuous physical soil/stone but still show too much brown earth and too few dense evergreen shrub masses relative to the photograph. Scanned low understory alone does not supply that missing crown volume.
The woodland has fine original needle geometry and no former lollipop/triangular crowns, but reads as young, open and hazy; mature canopy variety and lighting remain far below the reference.
The mature framing tree has broader boughs and a stronger rooted structure, but crown grouping and surface character remain authored and too regular.
Hall/roof/body silhouette, bracket richness, gilded surfaces, sky/cloud radiance, water highlights and veranda floor gloss remain visibly unmatched.
